'''Roona''' was the [[homeworld]] of the [[Roonan]] [[species]]<ref name="Alien Archive">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref> and was located in the [[Roona system]] in the [[Bes Ber Bikade sector]] of the [[Expansion Region]]<ref name="Appendix" /> along the [[Corellian Trade Spine]].<ref name="AVG" /> Roona was represented in the [[Galactic Senate]] by [[Senator]] [[Aang]],<ref name="TBoCW" /> and in the [[Imperial Senate]] by Senator [[Den Gane]].<ref name="Welcome Aurebesh">{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}} {{C|The [[Aurebesh]] text appearing on the monitor as Gane makes their speech, says "[[Senator|SEN]]. [[Den Gane|DEN GANE]] • ROONA"}}</ref>
